build.scope: V1/V2 new deployment; explicit V3 catalog and V4 jobs preparation and restore; catalog/jobs disabled until separately prepared; AI disabled; no deployment secrets included; database/cache images must be prepared separately

acceptance.scope: Linux amd64 V1/V2 new deployment plus explicit V3 catalog and V4 jobs preparation and restore; modules initially disabled and separately enabled after backup; AI disabled; no production or user database touched
checks: Explicit new deployment; random credentials; no implicit app initialization
Real Vue/Office resources, protected API, random login and default-password refusal
Actual inspector accepts signed proof and rejects tampering; nonroot Java; private database/cache ports
Repeated preparation/import rejected; credentials and database retained across app restart
Generated passwords and JWT absent from ordinary service logs
Native MySQL dump/import preserves every row including NULL, UTF-8 and binary; app remains stopped
Actual stopped host coordinator publishes authenticated encrypted snapshot, preserves existing output, cleans staging and keeps app stopped; no deployment restore claim
Actual new-project restore: authenticated SQL/private volumes, stopped ready state, explicit startup and original login, every-row comparison, collision and wrong-password refusal, source unchanged
Explicit V3 preparation after authenticated backup, enabled catalog API and enabled new-project restore; no automatic migration or ordinary grants
Explicit V4 preparation, real native job lifecycle and retained draft restart, proof/tmp backup, new-project restore and explicit restored draft submission; no automatic submission of temporary files
Nonempty database refused before schema import; original table and row preserved
